paragraphs.text: The scorecard's gaps generate the work (check: cmd/loop TestScorecardGapsBecomeProposals, cmd/loop TestTheGapsAreFiledOnceTheScorecardPublishes, cmd/loop TestADeclineBecomesTheRowTheLoopWorks). A cycle starts once the measured surface moved (check: cmd/loop TestLoopStartsACycleWhenTheMeasuredSurfaceMoved). A suite moved out of the gate still reaches a cycle lane (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/trainingworkflow TestEveryRetiredLifecycleFailureIsStillCaught). The landing scorecard reports and never refuses (check: internal/landing TestLandingMeasuresTheScorecardSlice). The gate writes the numbers a landing message carries (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestLandingSaysWhatAChangeAddsOfEachKind).

Before a landing the preflight runs the cheap stages alone, format, fix, vet, rules, invariants and the step's check (check: internal/landing TestPreflightRunsTheCheapStagesOnly, internal/landing TestGeneratorsAreThoseTheRepositoryHas).

Each structural boundary is pinned as a row of its kind's invariant table (check: internal/landing TestReachInvariants, internal/inferencesurface TestSurfaceInvariants). The gate writes each landing's lanes skipped, lane walls, and packages executed and cached (check: internal/landing TestLanesMeasurementLine, internal/landing TestRanPackagesNamesOnlyWhatRan). No fixed timer comes back, nor the deleted baselines and tracking records (check: internal/repoanalysis TestNoFixedTimers, cmd/gate TestClosureLedgerGone, cmd/gate TestGateRecordsGone).

A journey is timed from action to usable result, with loading, waiting, execution and display apart (check: cmd/recipe TestMeasurementSeparatesLoadPrefillAndVisibleOutput, internal/server TestWebUIBrowserShowsTheFirstTokenTime, internal/server TestCancelledDownloadHoldsItsSlotUntilItFinishes). The repository tracks no Python, and its runtime is Go (check: internal/repoanalysis TestPythonLivesOnlyInItsIgnoredPlace, internal/repoanalysis TestRSIRuntimeIsGoOnly). Pinned model_index.json declares MOSSImagePipeline, MOSSImageTransformer, MOSSImageScheduler, Qwen3_5Model, Qwen2Tokenizer and AutoencoderKLFlux2.
The transformer config declares 42 layers, hidden width 3072, FFN width 8192, 24 heads, text width 4096, timestep frequency width 256 and 128 packed latent channels.
The text encoder config declares 32 hybrid linear/full-attention layers with hidden width 4096; reuse Overgo's Qwen3.5 execution where its hidden-state contract matches.
The bundled VAE has 32 latent channels, a 2-by-2 latent patch, batch-normalization statistics and the small decoder widths [96,192,384,384]; the current latentimage QwenImage VAE and selected-layer Qwen3-VL conditioner are not drop-in implementations.
Pinned SFT safetensors sizes are 16785478992 bytes for the text encoder, 10164664216 bytes for the transformer and 249521372 bytes for the VAE: 27199664580 bytes before tokenizer, metadata, runtime buffers or caches.
Only the SFT checkpoint is an acquisition, serving and evaluation target; previously collected Base metadata remains historical reference material.
Resident inference memory is unmeasured and must include activations, attention workspace, decoder buffers, graph allocations and host staging; the 5B marketing size describes the transformer rather than the complete pipeline.

Parity targets the pinned released pipeline, not an unavailable training-time fp32-master implementation.
Default workload uses a CPU generator seeded with 42, 1024-by-1024 output, 50 requested steps, guidance 3, shift 5, empty negative prompt and negative-branch skip index 22.
MOSSImageScheduler snaps shifted sigmas to the nearest training grid and removes consecutive duplicates, so actual step count must come from the resulting schedule.
The pipeline wraps prompts with apply_chat_template(add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=true), runs individual unpadded encoder forwards with use_cache=false, and consumes last_hidden_state with a true-length mask.
DiT and conditioner use bf16; initial noise, prediction combination, Euler updates and VAE decoding use fp32; timestep sinusoids use fp64 before conversion and RoPE frequencies and phases use fp32.
Dimensions are positive multiples of 16 and prompt maximum length is 4096; preserve or explicitly expose upstream truncation rather than silently rewriting prompts.
Default CFG performs two transformer forwards per step; guidance 1 removes the negative branch.
Optional positive-branch SLG adds another forward and is deferred; unsupported controls must be rejected rather than silently ignored.
Deterministic import means the same pinned bytes and policy produce the same content identities, tensor mappings and recipe; it does not promise GPU bit identity across hardware or library versions.
Freeze numerical tolerance from independently measured oracle repeatability and datatype effects before comparing native outputs; do not widen it to accept a failed port.

Reuse artifact, hfhub, hfrepo, safetensors, tensorcatalog, modelartifact, modelintake, libraryintake and modelrecipe for acquisition, inventory, lifecycle and capability publication.
Extend the existing intake operation and CLI surfaces instead of adding a MOSS-only downloader, registry or serving process.
Keep architecture facts and defaults in versioned artifacts and recipes; implement missing numerical operations in the existing tensor, graph and media owners.
Generalize only where MOSS and a second real supported model demonstrate the same contract; preserve distinct conditioner, transformer, scheduler and decoder semantics.
Apply the broader Strata direction through exact dependency identities, stage-local execution, bounded residency and reuse of valid intermediate results, without inventing a parallel graph or cache framework.
Training-time gains are not an acceptance claim for this inference campaign.
Verification selectors below name acceptance work to be added by their rows; they are not claims that tests already exist or passed.
Use cmd/plan or the landing gate to execute row verifiers so missing tests and skips are rejected as vacuous evidence.
Hermetic and small-device parity belongs to the landing gate; full weight loads, quality sets and performance runs belong to the model-tagged improvement cycle.
Production syntax-node counts below are planning estimates for new behavior, not measured performance targets; narrow them when the first implementation diff establishes the required scope.

items.title: Settle the provenance of code that cites Torch and CUTLASS

budget.reason: Kernel licences in the bill are hard-coded (cmd/sbom/main.go:104-108), so naming a source needs a few lines of code.

steps.title: Add the notices the answer requires
steps.rationale:
kernels/cuda/ops_f32.cu:1584,6579 and ops_native.cu:64 cite Torch 7661cd9c and CUTLASS da5e086d, ops_f32.cu:2366 names 'pinned Torch CUDA owners', and torch_cuda_randn.cu:1 reads 'Ported verbatim from adaptive_new'. licenses/ and SBOM.cdx.json hold no notice for either project. If code was copied, BSD terms require one. The answer belongs to decision kernel-provenance.
go run ./cmd/sbom -check exits 0 today (measured), so it proves nothing here; the new test reads the cited sources. Rewording a comment changes source hashes, so the manifest and bill update with it.
Serves: a clean release.

items.title: Make a held-out verdict mean a real gain

budget.reason: Moving ConfirmOnPool and poolVerdict alone is 279 production nodes (measured with the gate's count), above the filed 250. About 700 with a reader and wiring, an estimate.

steps.title: Charge every held-out read
steps.rationale:
Exposure is charged only through ConfirmInstruction from the pilot (internal/trainingworkflow/instruction_pilot_run.go:261). ConfirmOnPool and poolVerdict live in a test (heldout_confirmation_test.go:227-246,254-268), and train -objective charges nothing (heldout_run.go:150-209): it reads the objective's split partner (:247-260) and holds no acceptance. No production code reads a pool's documents (heldout_pool.go:188,251 only set Sequence). The 24 records were read 24 times in an experiment copy (docs/verification/change-corpus-qwen25-05b.txt:6-9), which the real store's charges do not know.
The existing owner charges before the read: confirmOnPart (internal/evaluation/heldout_confirmation.go:115-220, charge :196, read :203).

items.title: Make scorecard readings say what a user would see

budget.reason: Estimate after the 675d61b80 recheck: video about 150 to 200, the other three about 60 to 120 each.

steps.title: Judge a quality decline against the level the model held
steps.rationale:
Quality is outside repeated (internal/scorecard/record.go:278), so it is compared only with the newest reading (:325-343). With no offsetting gains, five lost cases give a tail of 0.03125 against pairedTail 0.02275 (record.go:832,859; six lost cases file), and Propose only prints it (cmd/loop/improve.go:292-295). The next run compares with the lower value, so a slow decline never files. Timings already guard against this (record.go:150-153,264-270).
Compare with the best recent level and pair the cases of that reading. Non-headline qualities in row.Heldout take the same path (record.go:344-351,453), so the level covers them too, or a slow decline in a second suite still escapes.
Replay the recorded scorecards first to count what it would have filed, and whether the 0.0228 test across every cell needs a family correction.
Serves: held-out-quality.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: the replay and a table of slow declines.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: Count failures over a window of attempts
steps.rationale:
Counting stops at the newest success (internal/scorecard/scorecard.go:808-824), so a recipe broken 9 times in 10 whose newest attempt worked reads 0. A fixed window of newest attempts shows recurrence; the size is derived from the readings a run makes.
The present rule has a reason (:769-773): a fix closes the cell with its first success. With a window, scorecard-failing rows stay open (record.go:779, cmd/validate/scorecard.go:153-155) until failures age out, at about one attempt a cycle, and a fix could not land by its own check. So failures before the fix's commit leave the count once it passes.
Serves: failure-rate.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a table of attempt histories, a fix closing its row, and a diff of validate -scorecard before and after.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: Mark a quality reading that this run did not measure
steps.rationale:
Newest is set only on serving cells (internal/scorecard/scorecard.go:106-110,672,1263), so Unmeasured (record.go:112-113, called from cmd/validate/scorecard.go:65) never reaches quality, and after a broken evaluation the older value reads as holding.
Key it to a failed evaluation (MeasurementPhase.Failed, cmd/loop/improve.go:93-96), not to age. An older quality reading is normal: a run reruns only stale validations (improve.go:40-41) and carries results (scorecard.go:1178), so a time test would gap every unchanged cell.
Serves: held-out-quality.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a record whose evaluation did not run.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: Time a video request of the size a person asks for
steps.rationale:
Video cells time 21 frames at 32 by 16; a person's request is 81 frames at 832 by 480, about 6 minutes, and is untimed and its device memory unrecorded (README.md:202-208).
Add one user-size reading per run beside the small one. This is a new reading: Row.Lengths is inference-only (internal/scorecard/scorecard.go:749-751).
SQA-221 joins this step: cmd/validate/media_selection.go:90-92 still claims the sample is what the scorecard reports.
Serves: first-output and peak-device-memory as a video user meets them.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: one published reading.

items.title: Hold training's optimizer to what it states

budget.reason: Estimate. A finite check, two state fields and a rate count in existing owners.

steps.title: Stop a training step on a non-finite direction
steps.rationale:
norm < guard is false for NaN (internal/hostoptimizer/newton_schulz.go:63; internal/optimizer/newton_schulz_cuda_windows.go:254), so one NaN makes the group and its momentum NaN. Checkpoints catch that at publish (internal/trainingprogram/checkpoint.go:373) and route runs stop on the step (cmd/train/shared_run.go:90,93, with the misleading text 'carried no gradient'), but the dense token paths have no check (workflow.go:504, densecausal/train.go:103), so a NaN at step 1 spends every remaining step.
Momentum is written before any check (optimizer.go:106, muon_step_cuda_windows.go:90-95), so the stop must end the run. The guard refuses +Inf too: on the device a gradient of norm at or above about 1.85e19 gives normSquared +Inf, scale 0 and a silent zero update where the host steps normally (newton_schulz_cuda_windows.go:249-257, by reading).
Step has about 15 direct callers, so prefer a field on the step's result, checked at the two dense sites, about 40 nodes, over an error return, about 200. The norm is already read as a scalar, so no transfer is added. MOSS shares this guard and its route contains it.
Serves: hours not spent training a broken model.
Disappears: a misleading error text.
Evidence: a planted NaN gradient on the host and device paths.
Batch: training lanes.

steps.title: Record and judge the resident training schedule
steps.rationale:
Resident training runs 4+2 iterations in TF32 (internal/optimizer/newton_schulz_cuda_windows.go:218,225), used only by densecausaltrain/train_resident_cuda_windows.go:294; the host runs 8+2. Recomputed at rank 4096: update size 0.42 of the host's for a 1/i spectrum, 0.67 for exponential decay, 1.00 flat. The gap falls with rank: 1/i gives 0.53 at 2560, 0.80 at 896, Qwen2.5-0.5B's largest rank, 0.93 at 512, and 1/sqrt(i) gives 1.00 everywhere. Real spectra are unmeasured, so take a momentum SVD first.
Record schedule and precision in State, not Config: Config enters the session plan id and every seed (session_plan.go:84-90,126-144), and Restore compares it (optimizer.go:142). Add an oracle for 4+2, since newton_schulz_cuda_windows_test.go:106 compares only FP32, and compare descent at both on one fixture.
4+2 is matched and pinned: muon_step_cuda_windows.go:167 and dense_training_leadership_cuda_windows_test.go:30-31 hold optimizer:muon-4x2-tf32 by SHA, so a change rebaselines that test and TestCarbonMatchedAdaptiveLeadership. Keep whichever wins per unit time; if 4+2 stays, correct the scale rule. MOSS is not affected: it runs FP32 8+2 (muon_step_cuda_windows.go:299).
This lands before training-gaps/judged-proof: recording moves no number, but the decision can, and a no-gain result could otherwise reflect an unjudged update size.
Serves: throughput of training and honest rates.
Disappears: an unstated difference.
Evidence: loss per unit time at both schedules.
Batch: training lanes.

steps.title: Skip parameters that received no gradient
steps.rationale:
A zero gradient with live momentum still takes full-size steps for about 415 updates, because the direction is normalized (internal/hostoptimizer/optimizer.go:105-110), and an absent gradient becomes zero (internal/optimizer/tensor_pack.go:238-240). The reward path learned this (train_resident_cuda_windows.go:374-379).
Only the six GatherGradients callers can tell absent from zero; slab trainers cannot, and a present all-zero gradient still drifts. Stepper.Step has no group skip (stepper.go:5), so device steppers need a small API change. MOSS has no absent case: every projection needs a module (muon_step_cuda_windows.go:209).
Serves: frozen or unused parts stay still.
Disappears: drift.
Evidence: a group with no gradient keeps its weights on both paths.
Batch: training lanes.

steps.title: Derive the rate from trained parameters and correct the README
steps.rationale:
internal/trainingworkflow/workflow.go:220 and text_heldout.go:250 pass the plan's whole count, frozen tensors included, though the policy says trained count (internal/trainingprogram/optimizer_policy.go:23). That reads about 17 percent low for Qwen2.5-0.5B with its 151936 by 896 lexical table frozen. TensorPlan sets no Frozen (tensor_pack.go:88) and freezeLexical runs after training (text_heldout.go:591-593), so the count takes FreezeLexical at compile. MOSS counts trained factors already (route_moss_windows.go:255).
README:247,253-254 says a constant schedule, while scratch training decays linearly (scratchmodel/construction.go:384), and that only scalars cross, while flat and streamed steps copy weights.
A rate change moves recorded training results, so judge it on Qwen2.5-0.5B before it lands, and before training-gaps/judged-proof.
Serves: the derived rate means what it says.
Disappears: three README inaccuracies.
Evidence: a frozen-lexical fixture.
Batch: training lanes.

items.title: Hold a MOSS training run to its source and its data before it spends the device

budget.reason: Four checks in existing owners, an estimate.

steps.title: Refuse a served target before the first step
steps.rationale:
PublishServed uses os.Link (internal/mosstrain/publish.go:68) at the end of a run, after the checkpoint and before the held-out judgement (cmd/train/route_moss_windows.go:352-374). An existing target fails there (reproduced), so the run loses its held-out reading at its last step. A target on another volume should fail the same way (hypothesis). Check at the route's start that the target is absent and a probe hard link works.
Serves: failure-rate; no run lost at its last step.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: its test.

steps.title: Refuse a tensor of another shape before placing it
steps.rationale:
mosstrain.New places what it reads (internal/mosstrain/trainer_windows.go:149-155,182-193), and affine slices by the spec's width (:365-376), so a config that disagrees with its weights panics or reads past a device buffer. Hold each tensor's shape to the spec in the route's tensors closure, as inference does (internal/latentimage/resident_graph_cuda_windows.go:77).
Serves: failure-rate on a mismatched checkpoint.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: its test.
Batch: training lane.

steps.title: Hold a picture out by its bytes
steps.rationale:
Exclusion compares path strings (cmd/train/route_moss_windows.go:242), so a copy under another name or a case difference is judged as unseen. The published 32-frame reading drew from other videos, so nothing recorded is shown wrong. Compare digests of the bytes the run read.
Serves: held-out-quality.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a copy refused.

steps.title: Draw a training step's noise level from the source's grid
steps.rationale:
Measure first: read training_shift in the checkpoint's scheduler_config.json and the upstream training code. The route draws sigma = t/N and calls that the source's grid (cmd/train/route_moss_windows.go:286-295), while inference builds that grid through training_shift (internal/latentimage/nearest_schedule.go:23-26). If the shift is 1 the step closes with that recorded and no code. Also compare the route's P^-0.6 rate (route_flow_organ.go:139-141) with the P^-0.5 optimizer_policy.go:24-27 assigns to factors starting from initialization.
Serves: held-out-quality of a trained adapter.
Disappears: a false comment, if the draw stays.
Evidence: the value read, and a retained rerun if the draw changes.
Batch: training lane.

items.title: Find a training gap and judge the candidate with no person

budget.reason: Two steps, estimated at 150 each after the 675d61b80 recheck. The served-model work moved to row close-the-loop.

steps.title: File a training row from a declared target on a held-out objective
steps.rationale:
No gap asks for training except below-base, which fires only for a trained model below its base (internal/scorecard/record.go:574-584,783,875-876), so the loop's train arc is never taken. Cycle training is a proof of 1 to 3 steps with no verdict (cmd/validate/training_proof.go:16-38).
A route with no verdict is declared not applicable (training_quality_test.go:10-14), and Qwen2.5-0.5B has a verdict, so that predicate cannot reach it. A data file beside declared_trades.json names model, objective, steps, sequence, wall ceiling and required gain; goals and budgets stay inputs (skill.md:25). The gap stays open until a supported verdict meets it. Gaps group by kind and task (record.go:734-740), so the key must carry the model.
Serves: purpose: the system improves models through its own training.
Disappears: nothing.
Evidence: a filed row from a fixture scorecard, closed by a fixture verdict.
Batch: host lane.

steps.title: Prove gap to supported verdict on the smallest model
steps.rationale:
Run measure, gap, train and verdict once on Qwen2.5-0.5B and retain the record under docs/verification, as TestFirstRewardRunsRecordIsComplete does (internal/trainingworkflow/instruction_pilot_record_test.go:30). The test reads the record, so the gate stays hermetic and nothing trains twice.
The shortest path exists: train -objective -steps 128 -seq 512 -freeze-lexical publishes a session, a checkpoint and a verdict. steps.title: Freeze the comparison before any training
steps.rationale:

A full-stack 9B step took about 3 min 4 s (docs/verification/qwen35-9b-fullstack-training-run.txt:87-90), so a thousand steps is about 51 hours; Qwen2.5-0.5B took 0.47 s a step. Include a floor (a constant answer) and a ceiling (27B).

Disappears: nothing.
